claims.claim_text: The indexed Major Peter J. Ortiz is strongly matched to Pierre Julien Ortiz, whom the CIA identifies as a commissioned Marine officer and OSS member.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Colonel Peter J. Ortiz, the most decorated OSS officer of WWII
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index supplies Peter J. Ortiz, Major, and Box 577; the CIA supplies his full birth name, matching middle initial, commissioned Marine chronology, and OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact distinctive first name, surname, and middle initial plus matching field-grade officer and OSS context.
claims.temporal_assessment: The CIA dates Foreign Legion entry to 1935, Marine service before OSS, and OSS entry to January 1944.
claims.match_notes: High confidence rather than confirmed because the indexed Box 577 personnel file has not been reviewed.
